attributes.name: data
attributes.description: Array of unit objects to create

attributes.name: Name
attributes.description: The unit name as displayed in the AppFolio Property Manager

attributes.name: ReferenceId
attributes.description: Transient unique ID assigned by the developer. Used to reference individual units in the bulk-creation of units.

attributes.name: PropertyId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the property associated with the unit

attributes.name: Address1
attributes.description: The primary street address of the unit

attributes.name: City
attributes.description: The city where the unit is located

attributes.name: State
attributes.description: The state where the unit is located

attributes.name: Zip
attributes.description: The zip code where the unit is located

attributes.name: UnitTypeId
attributes.description: When present, the unit type can dictate fields like bedrooms, bathrooms, sq. feet, etc. Attempting to create a Unit with values that conflict with the Unit Type will cause an error.

attributes.name: Bathrooms
attributes.description: The number of desired bathrooms

attributes.name: Bedrooms
attributes.description: The number of desired bedrooms

attributes.name: SquareFeet
attributes.description: The size of the unit in square feet

attributes.name: Description
attributes.description: A brief, informative description of the unit

attributes.name: ListedMarketRent
attributes.description: The rent per month as listed on the market

attributes.name: ListedRent
attributes.description: The rent per month as listed on the market. This value reflects either the market rent or the advertised rent, depending on whether "Use Market Rent On Ads" is enabled in AppFolio Property Manager.

attributes.name: MarketRent
attributes.description: The unit's base market rent, representing its estimated fair market value based on current market conditions and comparable properties. It does not include advertised adjustments or amenity fees.

attributes.name: AdvertiseUsingListedMarketRent
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not to use the listed market rent as the advertised rent. Defaults to true if no value is provided or null is passed in.

attributes.name: CatsAllowed
attributes.description: The unit's cat policy. Enum: "Yes" "No" or null

attributes.name: DogsAllowed
attributes.description: The unit's dog policy. Enum: "Large & Small" "Small Only" "No" or null

attributes.name: Address2
attributes.description: Additional street address information pertaining to the unit

attributes.name: MaintenanceNotes
attributes.description: A brief informative message about the unit's maintenance

attributes.name: MarketingTitle
attributes.description: The title of the listing for syndication

attributes.name: MarketingDescription
attributes.description: A description of the listing for syndication

attributes.name: NonRevenue
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the unit is rentable and is a model unit, office or other non revenue unit

attributes.name: Deposit
attributes.description: The security deposit amount

attributes.name: ApplicationFee
attributes.description: The application fee amount

attributes.name: RentReady
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the unit is ready to be occupied by a tenant

attributes.name: Amenities
attributes.description: The amenities associated with the unit. Amenity names are case-sensitive. Cannot be specified when a Unit Type that defines amenities is assigned.

attributes.name: Tags
attributes.description: User-defined tag(s) that categorize the unit

attributes.name: LastInspectedDate
attributes.description: The date the unit was last inspected

attributes.name: YouTubeURL
attributes.description: The URL of the YouTube video for the listing(s)

attributes.name: AvailableOn
attributes.description: The date upon which the unit can be leased. The date must be within three years of today's date

responseFields.name: data
responseFields.description: Array of created unit status objects

responseFields.name: data[].UnitId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the created unit

responseFields.name: data[].ReferenceId
responseFields.description: Transient unique ID assigned by the developer. Used to reference individual units in the bulk-creation of units.
